sources.origin: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1 m bare-earth DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21, tile USGS_1M_19_x36y462, served by the 3DEPElevation ImageServer (raster OBJECTID 70295, locked mosaic rule). Exported at native 1 m on EPSG:6348, then block-averaged to 2 m and encoded in the browser for transfer (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md §2b).

transfer.encoding: 2x2 block mean -> decimetres -> int16 row-delta -> gzip -> base64
transfer.quantisation: 0.1 m (half the lidar's own 10 cm RMSE spec)

grid.sample: cell centre = mean of the 4 native 1 m cells

survey.quality_level: QL1 (USGS Lidar Base Specification: vertical RMSEz <= 10 cm in non-vegetated ground; >= 8 points/m2)

sources.licence: US Government work (USGS), public domain; no restrictions on reuse. Credit: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program.
sources.limitations: 2021 ground, before the course's bunker and tee rebuild: use for general landform only, never for bunker/tee shapes. Hydro-flattened water. Bare earth (no trees/buildings). NAD83(2011) vs WGS84 course outlines ~1-1.5 m apart (not corrected, below grid size).

coverage_lonlat_inner_box.note: largest lon/lat box fully inside the UTM grid (conservative); used by pcv3.py to decide whether a hole is covered

sources.origin: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1 m bare-earth DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21, tile USGS_1M_19_x36y462, served by the 3DEPElevation ImageServer (raster OBJECTID 70295, locked mosaic rule). Exported at native 1 m on EPSG:6348 for the area of Holes 1 and 5-9, block-averaged to 2 m and encoded in the browser for transfer (plane predictor), then losslessly re-encoded here to the same int16 row-delta format as the Hole 2 grid (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md §2b).

transfer.encoding: 2x2 block mean -> decimetres -> int16 plane predictor (z - (left + up - upleft)) -> gzip -> base64
transfer.stored_as: decoded and re-encoded losslessly to int16 row-delta (identical decimetre values; round trip asserted)

grid.sample: cell centre = mean of the 4 native 1 m cells

survey.quality_level: QL1 (USGS Lidar Base Specification: vertical RMSEz <= 10 cm in non-vegetated ground; >= 8 points/m2)

sources.selection: per hole: tools/terrain.py uses the first locked elevation grid (lock order) whose coverage box holds all of the hole's mapped points; Hole 2 keeps the hole02 grid

sources.origin: DERIVED: tree-canopy mask classified from USDA NAIP 4-band orthoimagery (tiles m_4107020_nw_19_030_20230822 and m_4107020_sw_19_030_20230822, flown 22 Aug 2023, 0.3 m, leaf-on) via the USGS NAIPPlus ImageServer (lockRasterIds 72824, 72826), resampled to 1 m on the same EPSG:6348 grid as the elevation source. Classifier: tools/canopy_browser.js (5x5 m mean NDVI > 0.19, brightness texture sd > 14, mean brightness < 140; 7x7 m majority), then 2 m cells = count of canopy 1 m cells (0-4).

grid.values: 0-4 = number of the cell's four 1 m sub-cells classified as canopy

sources.status: ILLUSTRATIVE (approximate wooded areas). Not individual trees; not field-verified. 2023 imagery predates the course restoration, so tree removal since 2023 is not reflected. Automated classification also catches some dense shrubs and lawns with tree shadows.
sources.cross_check: OpenStreetMap natural=wood polygons in the same area (ways 1241472152, 1241472153, 1241472154; relation 19103516; Overpass data as of 2026-07-28) were found and agree in general location; not copied.
sources.licence: NAIP imagery: USDA Farm Service Agency, public domain. Derived mask: project data.
